How ADA liquidation works

Cardano perps can trend hard for weeks; size for the move, not the candle. Liquidation happens when losses eat through the margin backing your position. The isolated-margin estimate is Entry × (1 − 1/Leverage + MMR) for a long and Entry × (1 + 1/Leverage − MMR) for a short, where MMR is the maintenance margin rate.

Worked example — 10× ADA long

A 10× ADA long entered at $0.16 with a 0.5% maintenance margin rate is liquidated at about:

Liquidation price$0.1448
Move to liquidation−9.50%

Because ADA can move fast, keep your stop-loss well inside that level and size by risk. See how to size a position and how to avoid liquidation.
